instruction: Candid black and white medium close-up at eye-level on a city embankment. On the left, the man with curly hair and a dark coat (R1) tightly embraces the woman in the black cap and dark coat (R2), who stands on the right with her back to the camera. He holds her close with his eyes closed, resting his head near hers in a tender moment. The background shows a softly blurred river and distant city buildings under overcast daylight.
elements: R1 rests his head near R2's head
R2 has her back to the camera while being held by R1
The scene is on a city embankment with a blurred river and distant city buildings
